title: SpatialESS: Efficient Edge-First Spatial Cell-Cell Communication
description: SpatialESS 0.1.4 implements spatial cell-cell communication inference using a CSR radius graph and streamed ligand-receptor scoring and permutation tests. It includes patient-aware multi-sample analysis with random-intercept linear mixed models. Materials revision materials-2026.10.23-r1 is archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23591306 and bundles the software source, figure scripts, saved research materials, and verification records.
